jobs.title: Senior Manager Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
About Unlimit

Unlimit is the global financial infrastructure for the borderless agentic economy. Designed to bridge the gap between fragmented local markets and the future of autonomous commerce, Unlimit provides the programmable operating layer for the world’s most ambitious businesses.
Through an integrated technology stack, the platform unifies global payment acceptance, programmable financial accounts, and digital asset rails into a singular financial layer. By mapping hyper-local payment ecosystems directly into its architecture, Unlimit enables businesses to move value and settle transactions instantly across continents.
Built on decades of hard-won regulatory depth and an extensive global license portfolio, the platform provides direct access to a massive global infrastructure. With major hubs in London, San Francisco, Singapore, São Paulo, and Mexico City, Unlimit is building the infrastructure that makes global expansion a matter of code, not geography.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
with a true headhunter mindset. You love the hunt: you go after passive candidates, find people who are not on the market, and keep going when the first, second and tenth outreach get no answer. You own your vacancies end to end, set your own pace and priorities, and don't need anyone to check in on you to deliver.
Your focus will be commercial hiring across the UK and Europe: senior commercial leadership and account management teams, from individual contributors to regional heads. From time to time you will also pick up other business roles as priorities shift. You will act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and executives.

What You'll Do

Own full-cycle hiring for commercial roles across the UK and Europe, from senior leadership to account management, from kickoff with the hiring manager to signed offer
Run executive search projects: market mapping, target company lists, talent pools, direct approach to passive candidates
Source relentlessly across LinkedIn, professional communities, referrals, events and your own network; build pipelines where there were none
Craft outreach that gets replies and turn "not looking" into "let's talk"
Advise hiring managers on the market: talent availability, compensation expectations, realistic profiles and timelines
Assess candidates in depth and present shortlists with clear arguments, not just CVs
Manage offers and negotiations, and keep candidates engaged until their first day
Keep Lever data clean and report on pipeline health and hiring results
Share your search know-how with the team and help raise the bar on sourcing

What We're Looking For

6+ years in recruitment, with a strong focus on sourcing and direct search
Proven executive search experience: you have closed senior and C-level roles through direct approach
Ideally, a background that combines a recruitment or executive search agency, an in-house team and an international fintech or payments company, with around 2 years or more in each. Other paths are welcome if you bring the same hunting skills
Strong track record of hiring commercial roles (sales, business development, account management) in the UK and Europe
Self-driven and autonomous: you plan your own work, raise blockers early and don't need micromanagement
Persistence and resilience: a "no" from a candidate is the start of the conversation, not the end
Strong stakeholder management: confident with senior hiring managers and executives
English at C1 level or higher, written and spoken
Fluent Russian

What We Offer

Fully remote role within the European time zone
Senior, high-impact searches with direct access to leadership
Corporate Claude license and the full sourcing toolkit you need to succeed
Freedom to choose your own approach
A team of international TA professionals to learn from and share with
Multicultural working environment in a fast-growing global fintech
Vacation, sick leave and paid holidays
Company-provided laptop

Join Unlimit Team now!

Unlimit is an equal opportunity employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

jobs.title: HR Manager Benelux - People Operations
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global leader in virtual care, with over 100 million users and more than 500 million annual healthcare interactions. We offer the only comprehensive virtual care solution that encompasses telemedicine, mental health, wellbeing, specialist medical advice and platform services.

Our Amsterdam team is growing. We are strengthening and scaling our local People Operations to create a consistent, employee-focused HR foundation for our continued growth in the Netherlands.

Role:

A hands-on, high-execution role at the heart of our people’s function.

This position plays a key role in running day-to-day HR operations while contributing to Teladoc Health's people strategy in Amsterdam as we scale.

Teladoc Health is looking for a hands-on HR Manager to take ownership of People Operations in the Netherlands. In this broad and autonomous role, you will ensure that our HR operations, recruitment and employee processes run smoothly, while acting as a trusted people partner to the Country Manager and local Management Team.

You will be the primary HR contact for employees in the Netherlands and work closely with colleagues in our regional and global People & Culture organization. Your initial focus will be on operational excellence, Dutch employment-law compliance, recruitment and employee experience. As the local HR foundation develops, you will also contribute to workforce planning, organizational development and other strategic people priorities.

Responsibilities:

Own end-to-end HR operations: contracts, onboarding, offboarding, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and employee records
Act as the first point of contact for employees on all people-related questions, from day-one logistics to day-to-day issues
Advise the Country Manager and local Management Team on people, organization and employment matters.
Ensure full compliance with Dutch labor law and internal policies, keeping documentation and processes audit-ready
Manage recruitment end to end for open roles, from job description to offer, as the main person driving the process
Build and continuously improve onboarding so new joiners ramp up quickly and feel at home fast
Take full ownership of HR processes day to day, prioritizing operational excellence and consistent execution over ad-hoc fixes
Identify gaps in current HR processes and implement practical, scalable improvements
Maintain accurate HR systems, trackers, and reporting so leadership always has an up-to-date picture of the team
Translate global People policies into effective local practices and identify where adaptation to Dutch requirements is needed.
Contribute to strategic people topics as they arise, including workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and org design input, while keeping operational delivery as the day-to-day priority

About You!

Experience:

At least five years of broad HR experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for HR operations in the Netherlands.
Sound working knowledge of Dutch employment law and local HR practices.
Experience with employee relations, absence management, payroll coordination and end-to-end recruitment.
Experience in an international, fast-growing, startup or scale-up environment is an advantage.

Languages:

Professional fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Digital skills:

Strong digital proficiency, including experience with HRIS, payroll interfaces, reporting tools and Microsoft 365.

Soft skills:

Essential: high execution power, approachable and easy-going manners, pragmatism, clear communication, with strong judgement, ownership, discretion, the ability to set priorities independently, and eagerness to grow with the company

Education requirements:

Minimum studies: relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

Compensations & Benefits:

The gross monthly salary for this role ranges from EUR 5,750 to EUR 7,000 based on a 40-hour working week, excluding 8% holiday allowance. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s relevant experience and fit with the scope of the role. In addition, we offer pension contribution, travel allowance, Teladoc Academy and a hybrid working arrangement.

jobs.title: Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner (Remote)
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike is seeking a Sr. Sales Recruiter to join our growing Talent Acquisition team. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast past and energetic environment delivering exceptional candidate and client experience. This person will act as an advisor to our hiring manager and an advocate for CrowdStrike as they may be the first point of contact for many candidates. This person will run the full lifecycle recruitment from conducting intakes to sourcing, prescreening, and negotiating offers. If you are looking for a role where you can make a huge impact with high visibility, this opportunity may be a fit for you!

This is a remote position ideally based in the Boston, NYC, Bay Area.

What You'll Do:

Proactively identify new candidates across a broad spectrum of roles
Engage and attract passive candidates through sourcing and fielding applications
Full end to end recruiting: sourcing, managing the interview process, prescreening, and extending offers
Building a good relationship with hiring managers to discuss needs and determine applicant requirements to deliver quality talent
Gain an understanding of the business and work closely with cross functional team ie. Human Resources, Finance, Operations
Build and leverage applicant channels (e.g., social media, internet sites, LinkedIn, Job boards)
Own individual candidate experience and provide each candidate with a high-touch, personalized talent experience
Understand and comply with all hiring policies, legislation, and guidelines
Managing weekly candidate tracking and reporting

What You'll Need:

5+ years of full life cycle recruiting experience in an agency or corporation. Previous experience supporting Sales roles such as Sales Engineers, Regional Sales Managers, Channel reps is essential
Experience working in a fast paced, high volume environment. Must have recruited for Cybersecurity or SaaS sales candidates
Strong sourcing experience, leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter and building Boolean Search strings
System savvy and Organized; using cloud applications (Workday, GoogleDrive, Word, GoogleSheets/Excel, Box) for documentation and communication
Proficient in Google Sheets/Excel for tracking activity; apply filters, sort, tables, basic functions
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

Experience working at/Scaling high tech, SaaS companies
Current recruiting experience is hiring for high profile Sales Representatives, Regional Sales Directors, Sales Engineers
Experience with Workday ATS
Familiarity with BrightHire
Attention to detail and appreciate the importance of accurate data

Benefits Of Working At CrowdStrike:

Market leader in compensation and equity awards
Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
Paid parental and adoption leaves
Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Clinical
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Upstream's Recruiting Team!

Talent Acquisition Partner - Clinical

Location Type: Remote (Must Reside in the US), strongly prefer Kansas City

Build Your Career with Us!

Upstream Rehabilitation is the country’s largest dedicated provider of outpatient physical and occupational therapy services. Our mission is to inspire and empower the lives we touch, to serve our communities, and to lead with purpose-driven passion.

We are committed to delivering remarkable experiences and fostering an inclusive workplace where differences are valued and celebrated. With 1,200+ locations nationwide, 26 brand partners, and 8,000+ employees, Upstream operates at scale while leveraging data, technology, and innovation to drive smarter decisions and operational excellence across the organization.

The Role:

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our growing team. Depending on your experience, this position may be hired at either the Associate Talent Acquisition Partner, Talent Acquisition Partner or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner level.

In this role, you’ll own the recruitment process from start to finish—partnering with leaders to understand hiring needs, designing sourcing strategies, and ensuring every candidate has a positive and engaging experience. For more experienced recruiters, there’s the opportunity to drive strategic initiatives, tackle hard-to-fill searches, and mentor others on the team.

Whether you’re an experienced recruiter ready to take the next step or a seasoned professional looking for a strategic, high-impact role, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

What You’ll Do:

Manage full-cycle recruitment, with an emphasis on hiring non-clinical and high-volume roles.
Partner closely with hiring managers and leaders to align on hiring needs, timelines, and strategies.
Build and maintain strong pipelines of qualified candidates through sourcing methods such as job boards, referrals, social media, networking, and direct outreach.
Provide clear, timely, and consistent communication to candidates and stakeholders, ensuring a seamless experience.
Leverage data and market insights to inform hiring decisions and optimize recruitment strategies.
Maintain accurate and compliant candidate records in ATS/CRM systems.
Contribute to process improvements that enhance scalability, efficiency, and candidate engagement.
For more senior hires: take the lead on complex searches, influence decision-making at the leadership level, and mentor fellow team members.

Who You Are:

Talent Acquisition Partner: 3+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience, including healthcare or clinical roles.
Senior Talent Acquisition Partner: 6+ years of recruitment experience with a focus on clinical recruitment and demonstrated ability to lead strategic initiatives.
Bachelor’s degree preferred; a combination of education and experience will be considered.
Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
Proficiency with ATS systems and recruitment tools (Greenhouse experience a plus).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with discretion and professionalism.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

The chance to directly shape our organization’s growth by hiring the talent that drives our mission.
Opportunities to stretch your skills—whether you’re building pipelines, designing sourcing strategies, or advising leadership.
A collaborative team environment where your ideas are valued.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing professional development.

Benefit Offerings:

Bonus eligible
100% employer paid medical health insurance premium option available
Dental and Vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Generous PTO and paid holidays
Supportive team and leadership invested in your success

A Better Place to Build Your Career

Upstream Rehabilitation offers meaningful opportunities across corporate and non-clinical roles, both remotely and in corporate offices nationwide. We invest in our people through leadership development programs, ongoing education, and professional growth opportunities.

Our corporate teams are critical to Upstream’s success—and to the culture that makes this a great place to work. You’ll join a group of talented professionals who collaborate, innovate, and know how to have fun while making a real impact.

Salary Range: $55,000 - $100,000

Estimated pay ranges listed above are based on several factors including but not limited to your pay class, experience, background and geographic location of the clinic

Benefits and eligibility are dependent on employment status and pay class (full-time, part-time, or PRN). Specific details will be provided during the hiring process.

Follow @Lifeatupstream on Instagram, and check out our LinkedIn company page to learn more about what it’s like to be part of the #upstreamfamily.

Click Here To Learn Even More About Upstream

jobs.title: Global Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description:
Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the leading logistics service providers operating worldwide. We offer tailor-made solutions along the entire supply chain for companies from a wide diversity of industries. From multimodal transports to perfect warehousing, from smooth customs clearance to innovative value-added services: We always keep our pulse on the times and are at our customers' side.

What you can expect:

As a member of the Global HR team of the Overland Transport Division (including approximately 9,000 employees), the Global Talent Acquisition Manager is responsible for planning, developing, managing and overseeing talent acquisition and recruitment processes and strategies.

In this role, you will shape and drive the Talent Acquisition strategy across the Division, ensuring consistent, high-quality recruitment practices while translating Group TA initiatives into effective divisional solutions.
You will lead recruitment for international roles and local top management positions across various European locations, from sourcing and selection through to hiring, using a broad range of assessment methods including structured interviews, psychometric testing and assessment centers.
Your tasks will include developing and standardizing TA processes, tools and best practices, including recruitment guidelines, interview and assessment approaches, job descriptions… while supporting and training HR and hiring managers on recruitment-related topics.
Furthermore, you will act as the Divisional representative for the HRIS Recruiting module and oversee the use of recruitment tools and platforms, including referral solutions, assessment platforms and job boards.
For a continuous improvement supported by data, you will define, monitor and analyze key recruitment KPIs and translate insights into actionable improvements across the Division.
You will contribute to employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives, partnering with the Group team on social media content, campaigns and candidate engagement activities to strengthen our attractiveness to key talent.
Finally, you will stay ahead of Talent Acquisition trends and innovation, bringing new market practices, technologies and approaches to strengthen our recruitment capabilities across countries and cultures.

What you bring:

Master's degree in Human Resources, Psychology or a related social science.
Strong experience in full-cycle recruitment, with proven experience recruiting senior management and leadership positions.
In-depth knowledge of assessment and selection methodologies, including structured interviews, assessment centers and psychological/psychometric assessments, with a strong understanding of HR diagnostics.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures and matrix environments, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Strong analytical, project management and communication skills, combined with a hands-on and collaborative approach.
Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an advantage.

What You can look forward to:

Continuous Training: Sharpen your skills and advance your expertise with our professional development programs.
Great Team: It's truly the people that make the difference - and with us you'll join the best team around.
Flat Hierarchies: Get straight through to the decision-makers with our streamlined organizational structure.
Room for Innovation: Turn your ideas into action in an environment that champions creativity and empowers you to lead change.
Events: From team outings to holiday parties and networking events, we build strong connections by spending quality time together.
Quick Decision Processes: Make things happen faster with streamlined processes that promote efficiency and effectiveness.

Location : Remote (from a European country where the Overland Division is already established)

Please provide your application in English language.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Join Upstream's Recruiting Team!

Talent Acquisition Partner - Clinical

Location Type: Remote (Must Reside in the US), strongly prefer Kansas City

Build Your Career with Us!

Upstream Rehabilitation is the country’s largest dedicated provider of outpatient physical and occupational therapy services. Our mission is to inspire and empower the lives we touch, to serve our communities, and to lead with purpose-driven passion.

We are committed to delivering remarkable experiences and fostering an inclusive workplace where differences are valued and celebrated. With 1,200+ locations nationwide, 26 brand partners, and 8,000+ employees, Upstream operates at scale while leveraging data, technology, and innovation to drive smarter decisions and operational excellence across the organization.

The Role:

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to join our growing team. Depending on your experience, this position may be hired at either the Associate Talent Acquisition Partner, Talent Acquisition Partner or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner level.

In this role, you’ll own the recruitment process from start to finish—partnering with leaders to understand hiring needs, designing sourcing strategies, and ensuring every candidate has a positive and engaging experience. For more experienced recruiters, there’s the opportunity to drive strategic initiatives, tackle hard-to-fill searches, and mentor others on the team.

Whether you’re an experienced recruiter ready to take the next step or a seasoned professional looking for a strategic, high-impact role, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

What You’ll Do:

Manage full-cycle recruitment, with an emphasis on hiring non-clinical and high-volume roles.
Partner closely with hiring managers and leaders to align on hiring needs, timelines, and strategies.
Build and maintain strong pipelines of qualified candidates through sourcing methods such as job boards, referrals, social media, networking, and direct outreach.
Provide clear, timely, and consistent communication to candidates and stakeholders, ensuring a seamless experience.
Leverage data and market insights to inform hiring decisions and optimize recruitment strategies.
Maintain accurate and compliant candidate records in ATS/CRM systems.
Contribute to process improvements that enhance scalability, efficiency, and candidate engagement.
For more senior hires: take the lead on complex searches, influence decision-making at the leadership level, and mentor fellow team members.

Who You Are:

Talent Acquisition Partner: 3+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience, including healthcare or clinical roles.
Senior Talent Acquisition Partner: 6+ years of recruitment experience with a focus on clinical recruitment and demonstrated ability to lead strategic initiatives.
Bachelor’s degree preferred; a combination of education and experience will be considered.
Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
Proficiency with ATS systems and recruitment tools (Greenhouse experience a plus).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with discretion and professionalism.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

The chance to directly shape our organization’s growth by hiring the talent that drives our mission.
Opportunities to stretch your skills—whether you’re building pipelines, designing sourcing strategies, or advising leadership.
A collaborative team environment where your ideas are valued.
Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing professional development.

Benefit Offerings:

Bonus eligible
100% employer paid medical health insurance premium option available
Dental and Vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Generous PTO and paid holidays
Supportive team and leadership invested in your success

A Better Place to Build Your Career

Upstream Rehabilitation offers meaningful opportunities across corporate and non-clinical roles, both remotely and in corporate offices nationwide. We invest in our people through leadership development programs, ongoing education, and professional growth opportunities.

Our corporate teams are critical to Upstream’s success—and to the culture that makes this a great place to work. You’ll join a group of talented professionals who collaborate, innovate, and know how to have fun while making a real impact.

Salary Range: $55,000 - $100,000

Estimated pay ranges listed above are based on several factors including but not limited to your pay class, experience, background and geographic location of the clinic

Benefits and eligibility are dependent on employment status and pay class (full-time, part-time, or PRN). Specific details will be provided during the hiring process.

Follow @Lifeatupstream on Instagram, and check out our LinkedIn company page to learn more about what it’s like to be part of the #upstreamfamily.

new_jobs.title: Global Talent Acquisition Manager
new_jobs.description:
Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the leading logistics service providers operating worldwide. We offer tailor-made solutions along the entire supply chain for companies from a wide diversity of industries. From multimodal transports to perfect warehousing, from smooth customs clearance to innovative value-added services: We always keep our pulse on the times and are at our customers' side.

What you can expect:

As a member of the Global HR team of the Overland Transport Division (including approximately 9,000 employees), the Global Talent Acquisition Manager is responsible for planning, developing, managing and overseeing talent acquisition and recruitment processes and strategies.

In this role, you will shape and drive the Talent Acquisition strategy across the Division, ensuring consistent, high-quality recruitment practices while translating Group TA initiatives into effective divisional solutions.
You will lead recruitment for international roles and local top management positions across various European locations, from sourcing and selection through to hiring, using a broad range of assessment methods including structured interviews, psychometric testing and assessment centers.
Your tasks will include developing and standardizing TA processes, tools and best practices, including recruitment guidelines, interview and assessment approaches, job descriptions… while supporting and training HR and hiring managers on recruitment-related topics.
Furthermore, you will act as the Divisional representative for the HRIS Recruiting module and oversee the use of recruitment tools and platforms, including referral solutions, assessment platforms and job boards.
For a continuous improvement supported by data, you will define, monitor and analyze key recruitment KPIs and translate insights into actionable improvements across the Division.
You will contribute to employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives, partnering with the Group team on social media content, campaigns and candidate engagement activities to strengthen our attractiveness to key talent.
Finally, you will stay ahead of Talent Acquisition trends and innovation, bringing new market practices, technologies and approaches to strengthen our recruitment capabilities across countries and cultures.

What you bring:

Master's degree in Human Resources, Psychology or a related social science.
Strong experience in full-cycle recruitment, with proven experience recruiting senior management and leadership positions.
In-depth knowledge of assessment and selection methodologies, including structured interviews, assessment centers and psychological/psychometric assessments, with a strong understanding of HR diagnostics.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures and matrix environments, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Strong analytical, project management and communication skills, combined with a hands-on and collaborative approach.
Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an advantage.

What You can look forward to:

Continuous Training: Sharpen your skills and advance your expertise with our professional development programs.
Great Team: It's truly the people that make the difference - and with us you'll join the best team around.
Flat Hierarchies: Get straight through to the decision-makers with our streamlined organizational structure.
Room for Innovation: Turn your ideas into action in an environment that champions creativity and empowers you to lead change.
Events: From team outings to holiday parties and networking events, we build strong connections by spending quality time together.
Quick Decision Processes: Make things happen faster with streamlined processes that promote efficiency and effectiveness.

Location : Remote (from a European country where the Overland Division is already established)

Please provide your application in English language.
